messages:
ana: Heads up: launching panama metro (pan1) with AstraSys + VertexAccel. Target 6w. Need quick owners: marketplace listing, capacity reserve, customs buffer, legal signoff.

matt: I'll own marketplace listings (AWS/GCP). Need 3-line blurb + logo from partners by Thu.

liam: I'll run capacity sizing. Tentative: 4x VTX-1000 + 2 standby. @julia confirm SKUs & power notes.

julia (VertexAccel): Confirmed 4 x VTX-1000 + 2 standby. Recommend 10% rack power headroom. Sending spec to @liam.

sophia: Compliance: Panama requires vendor security attestation and export-control doc. I'll draft an MSA addendum for data residency + KMS (customer-managed). Need AstraSys legal on SLA.

carlos (AstraSys): We can sign SLA. Request: allow customer HSM KMS and add +2w customs contingency.

ops-bot: Draft ticket CR-84421 created for capacity reservation (pending submit).

liam: Action list: (1) partners send logo+blurb (julia, carlos) Thu EOD; (2) sophia draft addendum Fri; (3) liam submit capacity after SKUs; (4) matt push marketplace draft Tue.

ana: I'll handle partner comms and schedule weekly syncs. :thumbsup:
